content.en_us:
How to get it :
- [[Ore Acidizer|Ore Acidizer]] : ore (plutonium), 500 mB sulfuric acid.
- [[Ore Acidizer|Ore Acidizer]] : raw ore (plutonium), 333 mB sulfuric acid.

Used to make :
[[Plutonium|Plutonium Powder]], [[gv:powder_polonium|Polonium-210 Powder]], [[Plutonium|Plutonium Ingot]].

- [[Ore Acidizer|Acidifiant de minerai]] : minerai brut (plutonium), 333 mB sulfuric acid.

[[Plutonium|Poudre de plutonium]], [[gv:powder_polonium|Poudre de polonium-210]], [[Plutonium|Lingot de plutonium]].
